title: Considering: `logger()` default format logs query strings
author: brookslybrand
body_preview: This is something we're considering, and it needs a decision.  ### Context  `logger()`'s default format uses `%path`, which includes the query string:  ```ts logger() // '[%date] %method %path %status %contentLength' ```  So an OAuth callback is logged with its code:  ``` [...] GET /auth/callback?code=abc123&state=xyz 302 0 ```  We got this from an internal team, who switched to `%pathname`.  ###...
